units: Unity metres after FBX axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y. Local +Z is the piece front (Blender -Y).
walking_line: Room-local XZ, origin at the room centre. Keep |x| < clear_half and |z| < clear_half free of solid cells below 2.2 m. That is the centre path and every door-to-door line, including rooms whose doors are not known yet. Flat floor tiles and the rail may lie on it.

recipe.crypt: Every room: one arch on each doorway; one wall panel (rotate carved, moss, crack, scorch by zone) and a trim on each solid span beside a door, using a wall slot; one floor tile somewhere; one overhead piece (chain, cobweb, or dripstone) in a ceiling corner; one solid corner piece (pillar, broken pillar, sarcophagus, urn, bones, roots, rubble, flowstone) in a free corner. Do not cover a chest (solid-wall centre, 1.1 m in from RoomSize/2) or a guardian point. Room 0: keep off the stair run (StairWidth 2.6, seven steps of StairRun 0.55). Arena: pillar_arena and rubble stay outside the 9 m spawn radius.
recipe.mine: Every chamber: a gallery frame on each mouth; one 6.4 m rail centred on that gallery; a lantern mesh on each existing post; an ore seam on a solid wall using a wall slot (do not use a vein whose along-wall offset falls inside the gallery); a timber frame on one solid wall; a barrel or crate or crystal or rubble in a corner. The cart goes in a corner slot in the deepest chamber, not at centre + 1.8 m.
